method: wails dev of the release tree with the version injected, against a local signaling server with request links on, driven through its dev page in headless Chromium; each shot is the card (or the Settings column) plus a 14 px margin, never the whole window
fixtures: three synthetic files with neutral names; an isolated settings profile and home folder; the request-link shots come from one link on the local server, used up by the test-only visitor in cli/internal/rlvisitor
